trial2_policy: Only a principled exact-arithmetic optimization justified by material measured regression/profiling; record its source hash/head and use the SAME frozen benchmark. No parameter search.

normal_workload.source: already inspected original synthetic engineering workload, not fresh market evidence

normal_timing.per_source_process: one untimed warmup plus one timed full run on identical events

normal_checks.identical: effective config hash, event stream hash, market event count, scheduler count, fill event count, filled quantity, end inventory
normal_checks.numeric: net/gross fees rebates within absolute1e-9; all samples retained

investigation_trigger: median paired candidate/baseline elapsed>=1.5 AND all five ratios>=1.2; engineering investigation threshold, not trading SLO or universal throughput claim

growth_regression.public_sequence: BID3@100 then2304 cycles BID1@101/ASK1@100, mark100, explicitzero costs, defaultguardunchanged
growth_regression.purpose: correctness and bounded growth diagnostic, no completed-work ratio for failed oldPR3

profiling_policy: Only after trigger, one separate cProfile pass on the SAME workload; never mix profile timings into normal samples.
stopping: Any source/config/event/behavior mismatch, accounting error or timeout stops and retains partial results; do not shorten or replace workload. After at most two implementation candidates report remaining exact-arithmetic limits rather than weaken accounting or chase timing.
forbidden: No global integer-string guard or Decimal context changes, market acquisition, E1 data, oldstudy reopening, fee/strategy/risk tuning, or remote writes until correctness/review passes.
